$comment: Independent interface and measurement contracts for the complete 993 dashboard F0 scope (issue #567). Written from the F0 assembly scope, the trim measurement plan, the PET identity audit (#566) and DT-01, before any functional CAD. Every value is null: nothing here is measured, and no coordinate is taken from the PicoGK concept or any other model.

candidate_variants.note: Contracts apply, but no catalogue identity can be attached until a source maps M564 or a specimen is admitted.

vehicle_frame.rule: Defined only from body features measured on the body: the two A-pillar faces, the windshield-base flange and the tunnel centreline. The trim plan's origin (centre of the central support on the cross member) is a part-local datum and is not used as the vehicle origin.

host_datum_features.description: Left A-pillar reference face at the dashboard height
Right A-pillar reference face at the dashboard height
Tunnel centreline at the console front

evidence_layers.catalogue_identity: PET text read in #566: part numbers, plates, positions, quantities and printed descriptions. Identity only; a catalogue never supplies a dimension, position or tolerance.
evidence_layers.proposed_measurement: The measurands in this contract. Every value, uncertainty and evidence field is null until a reading is admitted.

admission.specimen_gate: scripts/check_993_dashboard_pet_identity.py admit_specimen() must return admitted for the specimen before any of its readings is entered.
admission.reading_record: Each reading lives in a catalog/measurements/ record that passes scripts/validate_measurements.py, names the specimen ID, the measurand ID, method, repetitions and a bounding uncertainty.
admission.independence: A host reading is taken on the host with the part removed, or on a body feature that is not part of the participant being designed. A host value deduced from the removed part is refused, and a part reading is never used as host evidence.
admission.uncertainty_rule: Each reading states its uncertainty as a bounding half-width. Proposed rule, for the independent interface reviewer to confirm: a reading is usable for acceptance only when its uncertainty is at most half the tolerance it is checked against.
admission.contradiction_rule: Two admitted readings of the same measurand on the same specimen whose intervals do not overlap form a contradiction; the interface is blocked until it is resolved and the register records it.
admission.rights_and_privacy: Images and readings are admitted under #566 E5. No VIN, chassis number, registration or personal data is kept.

reviewer_roles.scope: re-reads every admitted reading against its images and record
sets tolerances and accepts or refuses each interface
every safety_relevant interface; required before any functional change near it

reviewer_rules: No person holds two roles for the same interface.
Model output, an agent, PicoGK or any generator cannot hold a role or supply evidence.
